issue_creation_policy: Only Codex may create new tickets/issues unless the user explicitly authorizes another model.

issues.title: Prevent old Sui package entry points from bypassing upgraded authority
issues.evidence: Old package versions remain callable and can still write shared state through unchecked old functions.
acceptance: Define authoritative new state that old entry points cannot modify; preserve required migration/history.
Deploy a prior package, create objects, upgrade and demonstrate attempted old-package report/authority bypass is rejected or cannot affect trusted receipts.
Document upgrade, mixed-client support and recovery.
issues.validation: Move tests plus actual old/new package and state migration acceptance tests.

issues.title: Introduce a network deployment manifest with per-type origins
issues.evidence: All dynamic-field types use the initial package ID; newly introduced types actually originate in the upgrade package.
acceptance: Record verified chain identity, latest call ID, per-type origins, shared IDs, protocol version and compatible client ranges.
Generate frontend/device configuration from one manifest and reject stale network/ID combinations.
Cover fresh publish, multiple upgrades and introduction of RecipeDigestKey/DeviceAddressKey in later packages.
issues.validation: Unit/generated-fixture tests and a live multi-upgrade origin resolution test.

issues.title: Migrate the frontend SDK and wallet integration to supported Sui APIs
issues.evidence: Legacy dApp Kit and Sui SDK are temporarily pinned together; the app still depends on retiring JSON-RPC.
acceptance: Migrate SDK, wallet providers/hooks and transaction execution together to supported gRPC/GraphQL clients.
Retain inventory/group/deployment queries, pagination, account/network handling and execution-effect checks.
Remove legacy API calls and document the tested compatible dependency set.
issues.validation: Frozen install, typecheck/build and actual wallet connect/sign/reject/chain-mismatch acceptance.

issues.title: Migrate the daemon reader, transaction builder and executor to supported Sui APIs
issues.evidence: Daemon queries and unsafe_moveCall execution still require deprecated JSON-RPC.
acceptance: Use supported transport and transaction building; verify chain identity and per-type origins.
Preserve durable cursor recovery, filtering, independent signatures and status effects checks.
Define historical/archival retention and handle disconnect/cursor migration without replaying applied work.
issues.validation: Rust tests, actual-daemon simulator adapted to new transport, and real chain success/failure/offline recovery.

issues.title: Generate and verify shared contract, event and recipe interfaces
issues.evidence: Contract signatures/event fields previously changed independently of clients/tests.
acceptance: Provide a generated or centrally defined interface for calls, events, keys, statuses and recipes.
Compare both clients to actual compiled Move interfaces and fail CI on drift.
Declare compatibility/version rules and reject unknown protocols before apply.
issues.validation: Positive and negative schema/interface compatibility tests using compiled contract artifacts.

issues.title: Harden publishing and configuration generation
issues.evidence: Unscoped TOML greps can mix environments; the publish pipeline suppresses errors and only updates frontend config.
acceptance: Parse metadata by environment and verify actual chain identity/account/UpgradeCap.
Stop on failed publish/upgrade/effects/metadata parsing and preserve prior config on failure.
Record release IDs/type origins and generate both client configs atomically.
issues.validation: Offline parser/failure tests, dry run and explicit testnet publish/upgrade acceptance.

issues.title: Add reproducible CI and release compatibility gates
issues.evidence: The repository has no automated checks for the repaired cross-layer flow or upgrade compatibility.
acceptance: Run locked Move/Rust/frontend checks and the real-daemon simulator on pull requests.
Record/pin tested toolchain/dependency versions and retain failure diagnostics without secrets.
Provide separately authorized live upgrade/wallet/hardware gates; do not publish in ordinary PR CI.
issues.validation: Successful CI plus deliberately failing contract drift, execution effect and recovery regressions.

issues.title: Implement revocable device identity and capability lifecycle
issues.evidence: Signer binding exists but there is no complete revocation/rotation/deregistration enforcement.
acceptance: Enforce active identity and revocation at authoritative on-chain reporting/update boundaries.
Define key rotation, reissuance, ownership transfer and legacy-cap migration.
A revoked or deregistered device cannot submit trusted receipts through old or new packages.
issues.validation: Contract adversarial tests, mixed-version upgrade tests and live rotation/revocation acceptance.

issues.title: Constrain updater and component execution privileges
issues.evidence: Recipe commands are opt-in and bounded, but execution lacks per-component privilege/resource isolation.
acceptance: Define least-privilege users, filesystem/resource boundaries and required firmware-only privileged operations.
Preserve authenticated recipes and process-tree cleanup on cancellation/timeout.
Document and test privilege failures without silently reporting Applied.
issues.validation: Negative privilege/timeout tests and service/image validation.

issues.title: Establish live wallet-to-device and package-upgrade acceptance suite
issues.evidence: Local tests do not prove supported public-network operation, per-type origins or security against old entry points.
acceptance: Exercise fresh registration, cap issuance, recipe upload, direct/group deployment and real execution effects.
Cover existing objects, later-introduced types, legacy caps and old-package attacks across upgrades.
Record environment/tool versions, artifacts and recovery; never include keys in logs.
issues.validation: Actual supported testnet/browser/device runs with positive and negative results.

issues.title: Create immutable component version catalog and platform manifests
issues.evidence: Component names/versions are job strings; no candidate catalog or platform/artifact selection exists.
acceptance: Register immutable versions and recipes with semantic version/platform metadata.
Resolve OS/architecture-compatible artifacts and expose version discovery.
Validate hashes, invalid versions and unsupported platform errors.
issues.validation: Catalog and selector tests plus integration deployment of different platform manifests.

issues.title: Resolve component dependency graphs and version conflicts
issues.evidence: No dependency resolver or coordinated install ordering exists.
acceptance: Resolve semver constraints, hard/soft dependencies and deterministic install ordering.
Reject cycles/conflicts before modifying installed state.
Support locally cached candidates when the declared offline policy permits them.
issues.validation: Resolver conflict/cycle/order tests and multi-component integration scenarios.

issues.title: Reconcile desired deployment revisions and live group membership
issues.evidence: Enrolled devices replay jobs; new group membership does not receive existing desired state and superseded versions are not coalesced.
acceptance: Represent desired revisions per target and reconcile latest applicable state.
Handle supersession, target removal, newly joined/offline devices and cross-group conflicts.
Define atomic multi-component plan/commit semantics and idempotent recovery.
issues.validation: Offline/new-member/supersession/removal/conflict and crash-recovery integration tests.

issues.title: Supervise component install, run, shutdown, bootstrap and recovery
issues.evidence: Only one-shot install/apply exists; run/shutdown are deliberately rejected.
acceptance: Implement persistent versioned workspaces, process lifecycle, readiness and restart policy.
Handle shutdown/replacement/bootstrap/reboot without leaving unmanaged descendants.
Expose genuine runtime state and enable UI recipe fields only after behavior is tested.
issues.validation: Supervisor start/crash/restart/shutdown/reboot-stage integration tests.

issues.title: Manage component configuration defaults, merge, reset and validation
issues.evidence: Nonempty recipe configuration is rejected; there is no persistent configuration service.
acceptance: Persist defaults and effective config with explicit merge/reset/JSON-pointer semantics.
Validate before applying and notify/defer components where required.
Keep confidential values out of public manifests and diagnostics.
issues.validation: Merge/reset/invalid-config/restart tests and component notification integration.

issues.title: Add health-based application and reboot-aware firmware rollback
issues.evidence: Applied currently means updater exit zero; no post-boot health or A/B rollback is implemented.
acceptance: Persist last-known-good state and application health rollback.
Implement a validated RAUC/SWUpdate A/B adapter with reboot intent and boot confirmation.
Distinguish ambiguous interrupted work, installation success, healthy boot and rollback.
issues.validation: Real-hardware power-loss/reboot/bad-image/health-failure recovery tests and simulator coverage.

issues.title: Coordinate canary cohorts, rollout rates and failure-threshold abort
issues.evidence: No rollout eligibility, rate control, bake periods or fleet abort gates exist.
acceptance: Define cohorts, concurrency/rate limits, bake/health gates and minimum-sample failure thresholds.
Devices verify authorized rollout eligibility; coordinator state survives restart.
Handle offline cohort members and audit pause/abort decisions.
issues.validation: Multi-device simulator and coordinator crash/offline/failure-threshold acceptance.

issues.title: Implement deployment pause, cancel, expiry and maintenance windows
issues.evidence: Deleting a deployment is not cancellation; jobs have no scheduler/expiry/deferral semantics.
acceptance: Model explicit durable control states and device-side deadlines/update windows.
Notify/defer safely before disruptive work and define cancellation during apply.
Expose actionable states/reasons in the operator UI.
issues.validation: Pause/resume/cancel/offline-expiry/maintenance-window race integration tests.

issues.title: Report heartbeat, installed inventory and device/component health
issues.evidence: No last-seen/health service exists; dashboard dots now correctly show health unreported.
acceptance: Publish bounded authenticated telemetry with installed versions and component health.
Buffer while offline and expose online/last-seen/degraded state without false health claims.
Separate high-volume telemetry from compact authoritative chain receipts.
issues.validation: Offline buffering/authentication/fleet status tests and dashboard acceptance.

issues.title: Collect remote logs, diagnostics and operational alerts
issues.evidence: Only local tracing/systemd logs exist.
acceptance: Provide bounded rotation, redaction, authorized collection/search and diagnostic bundles.
Expose actionable deployment/device alerts and controlled support access.
Never export keys, recovery phrases or confidential component config.
issues.validation: Quota/redaction/auth/offline tests and end-to-end log/alert acceptance.

issues.title: Provision fleets with scoped enrollment, roles and hardware signer support
issues.evidence: Software provisioning is manual; no claim enrollment, delegated roles, TPM/HSM backend or attestation exists.
acceptance: Define claim enrollment/bootstrap ownership and bulk onboarding/gas sponsorship.
Add scoped operator/deployer roles and an identity signer abstraction.
Validate supported TPM/HSM algorithms and rotation/recovery before claiming hardware identity.
issues.validation: Unauthorized enrollment/delegation tests and software plus available hardware-signer acceptance.

issues.title: Distribute confidential artifacts, secrets and rotated credentials
issues.evidence: Walrus/chain data is public; there is no confidential secret/config service.
acceptance: Implement encrypted policy-controlled delivery/cache with scoped access and revocation.
Rotate secrets without embedding plaintext in public data or logs.
Define offline cache expiry and deletion behavior.
issues.validation: Cross-device unauthorized access/revocation/rotation/offline-cache tests.

issues.title: Manage artifact retention, resumable download, cache quotas and budgets
issues.evidence: Uploads expire after short retention; renewal, resumable downloads and disk quotas are absent.
acceptance: Track storage expiry/renewal ownership and budgets with alerts.
Implement bounded cache/GC, disk checks and resumable validated downloads.
Handle expired/unavailable blobs and interrupted transfer without unverified apply.
issues.validation: Actual provider retention/renewal tests plus interrupted/download/quota simulations.

issues.title: Build a scalable fleet indexer, versioned API and operations CLI
issues.evidence: Browser queries scan history and there is no fleet API/indexer/coordinator service.
acceptance: Materialize chain/object changes with reliable cursors and filters/pagination.
Expose versioned fleet/bulk-operation API, CLI and integration events.
Document deployment/auth/storage infrastructure and retention/recovery.
issues.validation: Pagination/reorg-or-retention/restart/auth/load tests and API/CLI integration.

issues.title: Validate and pin Yocto image and first-boot service packaging
issues.evidence: The OE recipe uses AUTOREV and has not passed an actual BitBake build.
acceptance: Pin sources/toolchain/dependencies and add required Yocto cargo dependency support.
Verify binary/service/config install, provisioning, network recovery and state persistence.
Document supported layer series, updater integration and reproducible build artifacts.
issues.validation: Actual BitBake image build and boot/service acceptance on target hardware/emulation.

issues.title: Update the daemon safely with bootstrap handoff and fallback
issues.evidence: No independent recovery path exists when replacing the daemon itself.
acceptance: Perform staged self-update with persistent bootstrap intent and known-good fallback.
Preserve device identity, journals and protocol compatibility across process replacement.
Recover failed startup/reboot without relying on the failed daemon.
issues.validation: Process/power-loss and broken-binary self-update recovery acceptance.
